Locks on asks block any insert into related_checks or write_suggestions (an insert into a table with a foreign key locks each referenced table at executor start), so a timed-out check's record is retried in the background for up to 30 s (at most 4 retries at once).

The check's keyword arms use a check-only copy of search's SQL whose five ts_rank_cd expressions are replaced at init (a panic if any replacement does not happen exactly once); live search is unchanged.
Production runs keywords only until INFRA-394 turns meaning search on; the meaning constants (InputQuery, 0.25 floor, ef_search 400) are measured only then (P3 is INFRA-573's).

deviations: Recall set widened by the architect: every done INFRA close naming exactly one covering issue ('Duplicate of', 'Folded into', 'Superseded by'), later-filed survivors reversed rather than left out; acceptance became 'no fewer than the old query' (met: 5 vs 4 of 9).

The check's keyword rank is plan decision 3's fallback (idf-weighted coordination), frozen on the 3-pair set before the wider set was read; adopted because ts_rank_cd listed 3 of 9 against the old query's 4.
Search words for the not-made form are spelled from the title (or question) only, which cut the 10,000-word stage-1 p95 from 326-376 ms to about 210 ms without changing the chosen terms.
An ask on a document no project holds answers not_made ('the item it sits on belongs to no project') and is not recorded (a related_checks row needs a project); before, it searched every project.
The decision line also prints the decision ask's latest answer, options and text, since the one-item-per-owner rule can collapse an answered ask into its issue's item.
